items: correctness-1: One per-install presentation profile (language, register, audience) is the single source of truth; it is per-install state at ~/.claude/context/global/presentation-profile.md, never repo content, written by install/sync, and the global-context hook carries it into every session on the machine (interactive and smine runs alike).

correctness-2: The profile names the English-only rules it overrides and scopes the override to end-user-visible artifacts only; repo content, logs, results.jsonl, commits and operator artifacts stay English.

correctness-3: The profile directive carries a jargon glossary (banned engine/developer terms with plain-German replacements); code snippets, ids, dates, tags and gate fields are never translated or reworded.
correctness-4: Nightly consolidate is the drift-correction gate: the nightly threads the profile language into `/smine-consolidate proposals` (consolidate-as-gate only, no pre-render verifier).

correctness-5: The config-server UI gets a German overlay for the casual-visible surface (navigation, page headings, proposal card labels); English stays default and fallback; the html `lang` attribute is driven by the profile instead of hardcoded `en`.
correctness-6: Audience gating is a render-time filter over the same data, not a fork; switching the profile back to developer/English restores the full UI surface.

correctness-7: Casual navigation hides the engine-internal tabs (Skills, Context, Routines, Tools, Checklist, Config, Peek); the casual set is Overview/Sessions/Proposals plus the pages later specs add for that audience.
correctness-8: Casual proposal cards hide gate band, tags and target internals; code snippets render collapsed, clearly marked as technical detail, and untranslated.
correctness-9: For the casual German user, proposal titles, change lines, detail fields and evidence notes read as plain everyday German that needs no knowledge of how the mining engine works.
correctness-10: Engine terms (worktree, gate, transcript mining, consolidation) never appear in any text the casual user reads.
correctness-11: Navigation and page headings render in German for the casual German user.
correctness-12: The casual user is not shown internals pages such as skills, context packs or repo-management machinery.
correctness-13: Casual proposal cards show only what is suggested and why: no gate bands, tags or target paths.
correctness-14: Nightly runs keep user-visible content German and jargon-free; no English developer prose leaks in over time.
correctness-15: Technical code blocks are visibly marked as technical detail and left untranslated.
correctness-16: The operator sets the presentation profile once at install and the machine is configured without ongoing manual styling.
correctness-17: The operator can switch a machine back to developer/English mode and get the full UI and register.
correctness-18: Repo content, logs and pipeline results stay English regardless of the profile.

correctness-19: settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.de.md exists with `---` front matter `language: de` and the casual audience value (`casual`, per the later rename), and a body directing German user-visible prose, semi-casual register, the banned-term glossary with replacements, the never-translate list (code, identifiers, ids, dates, tags, paths, snippets), and the 'Technisches Detail' collapse rule; it overrides the English rule only for user-visible text.

correctness-20: loadPresentationProfile fails open: missing or unreadable file, missing front matter or missing keys yield language `en` and developer audience; an empty language falls back to `en`; any audience other than the casual value counts as developer.

correctness-21: cmd/hooks/global-context.sh scans `$HOME/.claude/context/global/*.md` before `$DOCS_DIR/global/*.md`, emitting the GLOBAL CONTEXT header once, honoring the existing GLOBAL_CONTEXT_ENABLED kill switch; shellcheck-clean and bash-3.2-safe.

correctness-22: routines/smine-nightly/run.sh sed-parses `language:` from the profile; when set and not `en`, the consolidate prompt becomes `/smine-consolidate proposals language <lang>`, otherwise the prompt stays `/smine-consolidate proposals`.

correctness-23: install.sh copies settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.<id>.md to ~/.claude/context/global/presentation-profile.md (mkdir -p first) only when SMINE_PRESENTATION_PROFILE is set; a default install plants no profile.

correctness-24: configserver gains `-presentation-profile` (empty = none) threaded into runInstall (Windows and the non-Windows stub); after runSyncs succeeds, installPresentationProfile copies the repo template into the home profile path, an empty id is a no-op, errors are wrapped in the file's existing error style.

correctness-25: smine.iss adds a TInputOptionWizardPage ProfilePage after RepoPage with 'Default — English, developer' (checked) and the German option; a ProfileArg function appends ` -presentation-profile=de` when the German option is selected and the [Run] entry passes `-install{code:ProfileArg}`; install.ps1 gains a matching -PresentationProfile parameter forwarded as `-presentation-profile=`.

correctness-26: settings/claude_code/CLAUDE.md's artifact-language rule carries the supersede clause: an installed presentation profile wins for end-user-visible artifacts; code, logs, commits and repo docs stay English regardless.
correctness-27: With no profile file, server output, hook output and the nightly consolidate invocation are identical to pre-change behavior.

correctness-28: DefaultPresentationPath (exported) returns ~/.claude/context/global/presentation-profile.md ('' when the home dir is unresolvable); main.go's `-presentation` flag defaults to it and lands in Options.PresentationPath.

correctness-29: internal/server/i18n.go `translate(language, text)` returns text unchanged unless language is `de`; germanCatalog is keyed by the English source string and a missing key renders the English original.
correctness-30: server.New registers FuncMap entries `t` (translate with the profile language), `langAttr` (profile language) and `isDeveloperAudience`; the Server keeps the profile for handlers.

correctness-31: layout.html renders `<html lang="{{langAttr}}">`; Overview/Sessions/Proposals nav labels go through `t`; Config, Skills, Context, Repos, Routines, Tools, Checklist and Peek anchors render only when isDeveloperAudience.
correctness-32: Pages hidden from casual navigation stay reachable by direct URL; no route is blocked by audience.
correctness-33: handleOverview's casual branch appends only sessionTiles and proposalsTile with a translated title; overview.html renders tile labels via `{{t .Label}}`.

correctness-34: _proposal_card.html hides target badge, gate band badge, tag badges and the gate detail row unless isDeveloperAudience; the snippet summary becomes `{{t "technical detail"}}` (Technisches Detail) for casual; comment placeholder, postpone, details, fields and evidence are wrapped in `t`.

correctness-35: Every literal the casual user sees on layout, overview, proposals, sessions_index, sessions_batch, _batch_list, _proposal_card and the sessionTiles/proposalsTile labels is wrapped in `t` with a germanCatalog entry; Go fmt.Sprintf composites may stay English (deferred).
correctness-36: A profile language without a catalog (e.g. `fr`) renders `lang="fr"` with English text and no error.
correctness-37: proposals.html renders the kind heading as `{{t .File.Kind}}`, the meta `updated` via `t`, and wraps 'Everything applied, happy' and 'file(s) failed to load:' in `t`.
correctness-38: proposals.html renders category, group and subgroup titles via `{{t .Title}}`, so free-form and path titles fall back to identity.
correctness-39: proposals.go vote tooltips format through translated format-string keys ('%d of %d accepted', '%d rejected', '%d postponed') using the profile language.

correctness-40: overview.go routes remaining casual-visible Go-composed strings (signalDetail fragments, the '%+d vs batch %d' delta) through translate, and overview.html window filter labels render via `{{t .Label}}`.

correctness-41: germanCatalog adds the canonical group titles and kind/category names with the specified renderings (New skills → Neue Funktionen, Edits to existing skills → Änderungen an bestehenden Funktionen, Workflows (skill-bundled scripts) → Abläufe (gebündelte Skripte), Considered, not proposed → Geprüft, nicht vorgeschlagen, context → Wissen, routines → Automatiken, rules → Regeln, actions → Arbeitsweisen, facts → Fakten, acdsl → Prüfregeln) plus the updated/empty-state/load-error/tooltip/delta strings.
correctness-42: Canonical skills-group titles stay verbatim English in proposal JSON (smine-apply routes on 'Workflows (skill-bundled scripts)'); they are translated at render time only.

correctness-43: smine-batch, smine-skills, smine-routines, smine-context and smine-memory SKILL.md each gain a Language contract: read the profile, and when `language:` is set and not `en`, author user-visible prose fields in that language per the profile glossary; never translate ids, targets, paths, code, dates, tags, schema keys, status values or fixed group titles; absent profile means English; each skill's frontmatter version and changelog.json[0] are bumped.

correctness-44: smine-batch's Language field list covers the sessions-JSON prose (batch title, themes, arc summaries, session summaries/notes, finding titles) while its `.md` report stays English; smine-context/smine-memory path-valued group titles are excluded by the never-translate list.

correctness-45: smine-consolidate's `language <lang>` makes all user-visible prose of the mutable set (proposed, unvoted) end up in `<lang>`, translating untouched entries in place including free-form group titles; fixed structural titles and identifiers stay verbatim; the grouping invariant and §4 Presentation are amended accordingly; voted entries are untouched; version bumped.
correctness-46: Developer machines (no profile) render every page byte-identically and the proposals/sessions schemas are unchanged.
correctness-47: cmd/sync/sync_hooks.sh's prune prompt reads `read -r answer || answer=n`, so EOF never prunes and never aborts the install.

correctness-48: internal/shell adds `SyncTimeout = 10 * time.Minute` and RunSync mirroring RunDialog; all four sync call sites (install_windows.go twice, contextdocs/sync.go, skills/sync.go) use RunSync and no `shell.Run` remains for sync_* or ensure_git_repo scripts.

correctness-49: On a casual-audience profile, sync_skills.sh jq-merges `skillOverrides: {<leaf>: "off"}` for every deployed leaf into ~/.claude/settings.json, preserving foreign keys and non-leaf overrides.

correctness-50: On a casual profile, sync_skills.sh writes the overlay ~/.config/claude-routine/skill-overrides.json with the same leaves `"on"` and merges it into the repo's gitignored .claude/settings.local.json; no `--settings` injection exists in routines/_lib/platform.sh.

correctness-51: On a developer profile, sync_skills.sh deletes the overlay file and drops the leaf overrides from settings via jq `del` over the current leaf list (idempotent flip when the profile changes).
correctness-52: run.sh copies the overlay into each routine worktree's .claude/settings.local.json, and the file is gitignored so publish never commits it.
correctness-53: layout.html casual navigation gains a `{{t "Projects"}}` link to /repos after Vorschläge; the developer block keeps the Repos link.

correctness-54: repos_index.html for casual: heading `{{t "Projects"}}`, add/remove forms kept with t-localized labels and confirm text, the additional-dir checkbox rendered only for developers, and a table showing only the project name/label with rows unlinked (Path/Context/ACDSL/Worktrees columns dropped).
correctness-55: handleReposAdd grants additionalDirectories whenever the checkbox is set OR the audience is casual.
correctness-56: The add op runs `git init -b main` (via internal/shell, no remote) when the cleaned path has no `.git` dir or file, before registry.Add; an init failure fails the add.

correctness-57: repos.Repo gains optional `Label` (`json:"label,omitempty"`), display-only, length-capped at 80, never used as the name/URL key; the add form has a label input for both audiences; Projekte rows and the developer Name column render the label falling back to the name.

correctness-58: germanCatalog gains Projects → Projekte, add/remove/Add/Remove, 'label (optional)' → 'Bezeichnung (optional)', the remove confirm string, and 'No repos registered.' → 'Noch keine Projekte.'.

correctness-59: New skills/smine/smine-orchestrate (SKILL.md + changelog.json) with argument-hint `<branch> | bootstrap` and allowed-tools covering Read, Write, Edit, Bash(git *), Bash(jq *), Bash(make audit *), Bash(go run ./cmd/acdsl *), Bash(bash cmd/sync/*), ToolSearch.

correctness-60: smine-orchestrate branch mode: judge main..<branch> (schema-valid JSON, make audit green, prose vs profile, auto-applied changes re-judged with bad ones reverted and their proposal set rejected), fix small defects on the branch, reject hopeless runs (no merge, reason to .orchestrate-report); merge into main (checkout verified, conflicts via merge-resolve doctrine, audit on main, red reverts and rejects); sync settings/hooks/skills; re-sync context packs per repos.json target; append missing registry paths to additionalDirectories (never remove); push origin main only when a remote exists; one report line per duty.

correctness-61: smine-orchestrate bootstrap mode judges the working tree with initial-setup framing (lenient on seeding volume, strict on schema/audit/style), commits directly with no branch or merge, then runs the same sync/reconcile duties.

correctness-62: run.sh parses `audience:` above stage 1; ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE defaults to 1 and SMINE_AUTO_APPLY to `decide` only for the casual audience; explicit env values win; developer defaults are unchanged.

correctness-63: run.sh stage 3 runs only when orchestrate=1 and both exit and publish status are 0: from repo_root via `routine_run_claude 3600 claude -p "/smine-orchestrate $run_branch"` with the routine_allowed_tools manifest, ROUTINE_MODEL default, `--effort medium`, permission-mode/budget defaults and JSON output, appended as result `orchestrate`.

correctness-64: Stage-3 postconditions: a dirty repo_root marks the stage failed (70 if it was 0); if run_branch is an ancestor of main, routine_prune_merged runs, otherwise the unmerged branch is logged and .orchestrate-report is printed; the report file is always removed; exit_status takes the orchestrate status when it was 0.

correctness-65: The Welcome page Bootstrap control posts to /welcome/bootstrap with hx-confirm; the handler refuses a second concurrent run with a conflict response, spawns the run detached (output to a log, pid logged) and responds started; GET /welcome/bootstrap/status resolves the newest running session via the peek client and renders session id plus peek link, else 'starting…'.
correctness-66: Welcome nav gating is plain `{{if initWelcome}}` (no audience condition).
correctness-67: The Windows folder picker change is evidence-driven (no speculative rewrite); the picker's owner form is shown and activated so the dialog opens in front.

correctness-68: acdsl/policy.json holds `mode: free`, `dist_mode: gated`, `base_ref: ""`, `editable_scopes: [GOLANG, PYTHON, SHELL, SQL, JSON]`, empty `verifier_allowlist` and `local_overrides`, `allow_task_contracts: true`.

correctness-69: acdsl/policy.schema.json is draft-07 with additionalProperties false, `mode` required, mode/dist_mode enums free|gated|strict, editable_scopes items matching `^[A-Z]{2,12}$`, string arrays for allowlist/overrides, boolean allow_task_contracts.

correctness-70: rules.acdsl adds ACDSL-JSON-003 (jsonschema, reach global, anchor acdsl/policy.json, schema acdsl/policy.schema.json, empty ok, needs the schema) with fixtures under acdsl/testdata/ACDSL-JSON-003 (pass: valid policy; fail: mode 'loose', unknown key).
correctness-71: LoadPolicy: absent file → free mode with allow_task_contracts true; a missing allow_task_contracts key stays true; malformed JSON and unknown mode return errors (never a silent free).
correctness-72: CheckPolicy returns nil in free mode and when HEAD is the base tip; otherwise it returns surfaceDelta, overlayViolations and ruleViolations(ruleDelta) diagnostics.

correctness-73: policyBase tries policy.BaseRef, then origin/HEAD, origin/main, main, master, and returns merge-base(HEAD, ref); no resolvable candidate in strict/gated is a hard error so `acdsl check` exits 2.

correctness-74: surfaceDelta flags each of acdsl/policy.json, policy.schema.json, registry.json, evalgen.json whose working content differs from `git show <base>:<path>` (absent on one side counts; absent on both is clean).
correctness-75: overlayViolations reads acdsl/registry.local.json directly (tracked or untracked) and flags every entry name not listed in local_overrides.

correctness-76: ruleDelta parses declaration files changed vs base plus untracked ones on both sides and classifies rules added/removed/changed, where changed means the TrimSpace'd marker line differs; base-side authoring violations are ignored.

correctness-77: ruleViolations: strict flags every delta entry; gated flags entries whose SCOPE segment (id regex capture 2; non-matching ids are protected) is outside editable_scopes, plus added/changed entries binding a verifier outside the allowlist (empty → names in the base-ref registry); task-lifetime entries are dropped first when allow_task_contracts.
correctness-78: Policy diagnostics use Message `<file>:<line>: policy(<mode>): rule <id> added|modified|removed outside <detail>`, RuleId `ACDSL-POLICY`, Verifier `policy`, and a Why naming the fix.

correctness-79: internal/acdsl/git.go adds GitMergeBase, GitRevParse (error carries stderr), GitChangedFiles (diff --name-only plus untracked non-ignored) and GitShowFile (absent path → ok=false, not an error), all through internal/shell.Run.

correctness-80: runCheck loads the policy and runs CheckPolicy after LoadRegistry (errors → exitError) and prepends policy diagnostics before logVerdicts; the enforcement is compiled into bin/acdsl, not a registry verifier; the file doc comment mentions the policy gate.

correctness-81: Dist ships the policy via writePolicy: mode rewritten from dist_mode (falling back to the source mode), dist_mode stripped, schema copied verbatim; no source policy ships nothing; the output gains `  acdsl/policy.json -> mode: <mode>`.

correctness-82: cmd/hooks/acdsl-policy-guard.sh exits 0 (fail-open) without jq, without cwd/file_path, without a policy root found walking up, for free mode, or for paths outside the root; in gated/strict it denies writes to policy.json, policy.schema.json, registry.json, registry.local.json and evalgen.json; strict also denies `*.acdsl` and `acdsl/*`; deny JSON matches the worktree-write-guard shape.

correctness-83: settings/claude_code/settings.json registers `bash ~/.claude/hooks/acdsl-policy-guard.sh` (timeout 10) in the PreToolUse Write|Edit|NotebookEdit hooks array after worktree-write-guard.

correctness-84: acdsl/README.md gains a Modes section (three modes, base-branch privilege boundary, dist_mode, local_overrides, task-contract exemption, copy-paste permissions.deny snippet) and an amended registry.local.json paragraph; docs/acdsl-spec.md gains a self-management modes paragraph.
correctness-85: railroad-review.js lanePrompt invokes the Skill tool with skill="railroad-review" and args="--no-context" (CTX-002); `no-context` appears at exactly that site.
correctness-86: railroad-review SKILL.md's CTX-002 parenthetical names the real mechanism (lanes invoke the skill with --no-context) instead of 'they never invoke a skill'.
correctness-87: railroad-review version moves 8.2 → 8.3 in frontmatter and changelog.json[0], with an entry naming the lane-context fix and the branch rename.

correctness-88: Lane, refuter and station branch builders produce `claude-review/{direction}[-{chunkSlug}]-l{i}-r{r}-{hash6}`, `claude-review/refute-{slug}-r{r}-{hash6}` and `claude-review/station-r{r}-{hash6}`.

correctness-89: Every 'claude/* namespace' mention in lane/refuter/station prompts, cleanup notes and SKILL.md becomes 'claude-review/* namespace'; `claude/railroad` has zero matches under skills/quality/railroad-review/.
correctness-90: runCleanup's enumeration derives from the same builders, so the rename leaves no claude-review/* branches behind after a round.

correctness-91: plans/railroad-review-observability/runbooks/trace.md holds jq recipes over on-disk workflow transcripts (lane roster, context reads per lane, injection check, cost, step adherence) plus the before/after procedure, with no peek-mcp dependency.

correctness-92: plans/railroad-review-observability/runbooks/eviction-screen.md defines the candidate rule (across ≥3 runs: never read by a lane whose direction requires it, never cited, enforcement not gate|lint) and outputs to evals/railroad-review-<date>/eviction-candidates.md as input to a manual tombstone; no confidence/usage metadata is added to context entries.
correctness-93: skill-context.sh and read-gate.sh are unchanged.

correctness-94: welcome.html Bootstrap card is a form (hx-post /welcome/bootstrap, hx-confirm, hx-disabled-elt) with `<input type="date" name="since">` prefilled with today−30d and max today, an `extra-prompt` text input (maxlength 500), and a submit button; BootstrapSinceDefault/BootstrapToday are computed in the welcome handler (2006-01-02 format).

correctness-95: smine SKILL.md gains `--since <YYYY-MM-DD>` passed verbatim to smine-batch (argument-hint, Args summary, §1 Resolve, §2 Run), and session-mine.js forwards args.since like agents; version bumped.
correctness-96: smine-batch `--since`: at Select, sessions whose `last_active` is before the date (inclusive floor) are dropped before batching and never listed as skipped; version bumped.
correctness-97: presentation.go defines `audienceCasual = "casual"`; isDeveloperAudience returns Audience != casual, so a legacy `non-developer` value behaves as developer.

correctness-98: sync_skills.sh migrates `audience: non-developer` to `audience: casual` in place (sed to tmp + mv) before reading the audience, compares against `casual`, and its comment speaks of casual installs.
correctness-99: routines/smine-nightly/run.sh compares the audience against `casual` for the orchestrate and auto-apply defaults.
correctness-100: The German profile template writes `audience: casual` and 'casual user' prose; the Windows installer label reads 'Deutsch - nicht-technisch (German, casual)'.
correctness-101: Rename sweep: skill/doc prose and comments naming the mode say casual; `grep -rn non-developer` is zero outside plans/, sessions/, evals/, .claude/worktrees/.

correctness-102: smine-apply and skillroutine-create stamp `origin: user` (one line after `author:`) on every skill created from a proposal; never on shipped skills, never removed; both changelogs bumped.

correctness-103: smine-skills §2: with `audience: casual`, skill/workflow edit candidates whose target lacks `origin: user` are dropped, never written to skills.json, and listed in the run report as `dropped: casual lockout — <target>`; new-skill proposals stay allowed.

correctness-104: smine-apply hard gate: on casual, a skills-kind proposal against an existing skill without `origin: user` leaves the skill untouched and gets disposition `casual-locked` with a note, regardless of vote or auto-apply mode.
correctness-105: smine-orchestrate rejects, on a casual install, any run-branch commit modifying a skills/*/*/SKILL.md (or its bundled files) that lacks `origin: user`.

correctness-106: smine-batch routes each session to `sessions/<repo-name>/` by `--repos` attribution, or `sessions/default/` when unmatched or no roster; folders created on first use; `archived` and `default` reserved and archived/ never a mining target; batches never span folders, size 10 per folder, numbering per folder from 01; `.batch.scope` carries the folder name; JSON goes to sessions/<name>/json/.

correctness-107: smine-batch ledger is sessions/<name>/analyzed-sessions.txt appended per batch; the Select skip-list is the union of sessions/*/analyzed-sessions.txt and sessions/archived/*/analyzed-sessions.txt (the §0 doc drift naming sessions/analyzed-sessions.txt is fixed).

correctness-108: `--scopes` is removed from smine (description, argument-hint, Args, §1 Resolve, §2 Run, session-mine.js args) and smine-batch; schema.json batch.scope description reads as folder name (repo roster name or default); smine `--no-batch` cursor resolution covers every folder under sessions/ except archived/.
correctness-109: smine-skills, smine-context, smine-routines and smine-memory read batch reports from every folder under sessions/ except archived/ (versions bumped).
correctness-110: internal/sessions store enumeration skips the `archived` directory.

correctness-111: Store.ArchiveScope moves sessions/<name> to sessions/archived/<name> (creating archived/, error if already archived); UnarchiveScope moves it back and errors if a live folder of that name exists; DeleteScope removes only an archived folder (error otherwise); ArchivedFolders lists archived folders with md-report counts (missing dir = empty); validateScopeName rejects '', 'archived', '.', '..', separators and non-base names while `default` stays archivable.

correctness-112: Routes GET /sessions/archive, POST /sessions/{scope}/archive, POST /sessions/archive/{name}/unarchive, POST /sessions/archive/{name}/delete exist; the op handlers render the op result and set HX-Redirect (/sessions after archive, /sessions/archive after unarchive/delete) without an explicit store reload.

groups.id: spec-8-change-bootstrap-profile (sessions UI, reload removal, repo names)
items: correctness-113: The Reload-from-disk button, `POST /sessions/reload` (now 404), handleSessionsReload, the `sessions-reload` HX-Trigger wiring and the 'Reload from disk' catalog entry are gone; handleSessionsIndex, handleSessionsScope, handleSessionsBatch, handleSessionsArchiveTab and handleOverview call the store's Reload() first (error logged, page still renders).

correctness-114: sessions_index.html tabs row ends with an archive tab link; the active folder has an 'Archive folder' form (hx-post /sessions/{scope}/archive with the localized confirm); batch-list-wrap is a plain div; the empty state also shows the tabs row.

correctness-115: New sessions_archive.html lists archived folders with report counts, an Unarchive form and a Delete form whose confirm names the re-mining consequence, plus a 'No archived folders.' empty state; the new labels and confirm texts are in germanCatalog.

correctness-116: Repo add form gains an editable Name input (placeholder 'name (default: folder name)'); handleReposAdd uses it, falling back to the path basename, and validates the name before running git init.
correctness-117: Repo.Validate rejects the reserved names `default` and `archived`; duplicate names keep being rejected with the existing error.
correctness-118: Removing a repo from the registry leaves its sessions folder untouched; existing sessions/personal and sessions/work are not migrated and stay reachable until archived.
correctness-119: run.sh comments, smine-orchestrate prose and README's sessions-layout description use repo-folder / default / archived wording instead of scope dirs or work/personal.

correctness-120: cmd/bootstrap/run.sh exists: `set -uo pipefail`, exports MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 and MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*', resolves repo_root from the script dir, sources routines/_lib/platform.sh and skill.sh, bash-3.2-safe and shellcheck-clean; the header documents BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_FILE, BOOTSTRAP_SINCE, BOOTSTRAP_N, BOOTSTRAP_EXTRA_PROMPT, BOOTSTRAP_DRY_RUN.

correctness-121: Preflight: a branch other than main exits 64, a dirty tree exits 64, missing jq/shellcheck only warns; outside dry-run a missing or empty token file exits 78, otherwise CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is exported from it.
correctness-122: The wrapper reads language/audience/dev-mode from the profile via sed; dev mode comes from SMINE_DEV_MODE or `dev-mode: true`, and the casual audience forces it off.
correctness-123: Outside dry-run the casual skill overlay is copied to the repo's .claude/settings.local.json; the --repos roster is built from additionalDirectories entries that are git dirs.

correctness-124: Mine prompt is `/smine --nightly` plus `--since <d>` XOR `--last <n>` (BOOTSTRAP_N default 30), `--dev` when dev mode, `--repos`, `--agents ${SMINE_AGENTS:-claude,codex}`, then the extra prompt; consolidate adds `language <lang>` when not en; apply uses a fresh empty votes-processing-<ts>.jsonl (created outside dry-run), cap and `(auto-apply: decide; rules-file: …)`; orchestrate is `/smine-orchestrate bootstrap` plus `(since: <d>)` when given.

correctness-125: run_stage passes `--allowedTools` from routine_allowed_tools (warning when empty), `--add-dir $HOME/.claude/context/global`, model/effort/permission-mode/budget defaults and JSON output through routine_run_claude, logs a JSON envelope line per stage to the results file, never aborts the run, and records the first failing status as overall_status.

correctness-126: Stages run in order smine-style (`/smine-style $n`) → smine → smine-consolidate → smine-apply → smine-orchestrate, orchestrate always running; BOOTSTRAP_DRY_RUN=1 prints one DRY line per stage and executes nothing.
correctness-127: Postconditions: a dirty tree after the stages prints the .orchestrate-report (if any) and exits 70; otherwise .orchestrate-report is removed and the script exits overall_status.
